interpretation: FloatRangeWithIntervalUniqueAffixPityBonus(SharedRandomFloat(), step, min, max) is read as an inclusive roll from min to max. The first number after the random source is stored as step and is not applied as a filter. FloatRandomRangeWithIntervalUniqueAffixPityBonus(step, min, max) is the same triple with the random source left out. That order is unverified. It is the order that reproduces Furnace 75–100, Tuskhelm 40–50, Leoric 35–50, and the Blood-Mad Idol affix 80–100. On Ramaladni the stored step is 10 while the raw roll is 0.0035–0.005, so that first number may be an interval count instead of an absolute step. The raw argument is kept either way. arMaxLegendaryRanks is stored. bIgnoreLegendaryScaling is stored. Neither is applied to min or max. Masterwork, greater-affix, and legendary-rank scaling are not in these three arguments. A tooltip token Affix_Value_N*100 multiplies the parsed min and max by 100 before they are compared with a percent. The format specifier is read from that token: %x is multiplicative [x], %+ is additive [+], and a bare % is a plain percent with a null damage bucket. fAllowedForPlayerClass index 2 is Barbarian. A record is in scope when that index is 1, when every index is 1, or when every index is 0. Other indexes are not given class names.
